problem: Docker needed sustainable revenue from its widely used developer tool.
title: Docker Desktop requires paid subscriptions for larger companies
context: Docker Desktop had been free for all users, including large companies.
decision_made: Keep Docker Desktop free for personal use, education, open source and small businesses, and require a paid subscription for larger ones.
action_taken: New terms took effect on 31 August 2021 with a grace period to 31 January 2022. The free plan was renamed Docker Personal.
observed_outcome: Not documented in the sources used.
lessons: Thresholds based on company size let a vendor monetize heavy commercial use while keeping individuals free.
limitations: Thresholds were fewer than 250 employees and under $10 million revenue. Some press described them more loosely. Revenue and migration effects were not found.

claims.claim_text: Docker Desktop stayed free for small businesses and personal use while larger companies needed a paid subscription.
Docker published updated product subscriptions in a press release.
